sasha: VectorOps SI hit a showstopper during NexisHealth cutover this morning: image signature failed and GPU driver probe errors. Need partnerships + marketplace triage.
lee: What exact errors?
sasha: They saw 'verification failed: signature mismatch' pulling redwood/edge and then when rebuilding locally GPU init failed with vermagic mismatch.
marco: Signature issues usually mean they pulled by tag not digest or cosign/public key missing. Driver vermagic points to kernel headers mismatch (they mentioned FIPS-patched kernel).
alyssa: Asked for docker inspect repo digests and cosign output. SI returned only tag, cosign "public key not found".
marketplace-build: No key rotation today. I uploaded public cosign key and a signed digest URL to the secure SI folder.
hw-partner-bot: [hw-partner-bot] Note: Some vendor drivers require kernel ABI unpatched; for FIPS kernels vendor recommends DKMS build.
sasha: VectorOps needs a short recovery plan: 1) get service back, 2) verify image integrity, 3) doc for next installs.
alyssa: Recovery options: - Pull by sha and verify with cosign (we'll provide key). - If drivers incompatible, use hosted Redwood endpoints as temporary fallback.
lee: SI compliance might block using our image. We should prepare a minimal audit guide so they can add compliance agents post-boot instead of rebuilding image.
marco: I'll draft DKMS checklist and a 'post-boot agent install' snippet. Also include diagnostics: RW_TRACE_ID, docker inspect, dmesg around probe, modinfo nvidia.
marketplace-build: Created signed URL: https://marketplace.redwood.com/signed/redwood-edge-3.9.0.sha256 (TTL 48h). Public key placed in secure SI folder. Build matrix confirms nvidia-525 built against 5.15 base.
alyssa: I'll open a short security ticket for hosted fallback (allowlist) and post the ticket id here.
sasha: VectorOps will try DKMS now (~90m). If that fails, they'll request expedited compliance sign-off to use our signed digest. We'll reconvene here with updates. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
